mukta-m0-p19-v451.quick_english: The meaning is that through the practice of yoga, omniscience and other such powers manifest right here.

mukta-m0-p19-v452.quick_english: Rivers, countries, gardens, cities, and so forth arise by one's own play.

mukta-m0-p19-v453.quick_english: Obeisance to such a one, our teacher, whose splendor is Śiva.

mukta-m0-p19-v454.quick_english: By one whose mind has been purified by the light composed by Rāmakaṇṭha.

mukta-m0-p19-v455.quick_english: The purpose of the examination of the triad of jewels has been revealed in brief.

mukta-m0-p19-v451.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p19-v451.question: How does yoga practice bring about the manifestation of omniscience and related powers in this very state?
premises: Yoga practice serves as the cause of manifestation.
Omniscience and similar powers are the manifested qualities.
This manifestation occurs in the present context.
mukta-m0-p19-v451.inference: Therefore, through yoga practice, omniscience and related powers manifest here.

mukta-m0-p19-v452.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p19-v452.question: By what mode of activity are rivers, countries, gardens, cities, and similar forms brought forth?
premises: Rivers, countries, gardens, cities, and other forms are enumerated.
These forms arise through an agent's activity.
The activity is characterized as one's own play.
mukta-m0-p19-v452.inference: Therefore, such forms are brought forth by one's own playful activity.
uncertainties: The agent performing the play is implicit from context.

mukta-m0-p19-v453.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p19-v453.question: To whom is reverential obeisance offered as the teacher possessing the splendor of Śiva?
premises: Obeisance is directed to a recipient.
The recipient is identified as our teacher.
The teacher is characterized as having the splendor of Śiva.
mukta-m0-p19-v453.inference: Therefore, obeisance is offered to our teacher who is of such nature and possesses Śiva's splendor.

mukta-m0-p19-v454.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p19-v454.question: By what means and by whom is the mind purified in relation to the composed illumination?
premises: An illumination was composed by Rāmakaṇṭha.
The mind is described as purified.
The purification is associated with that illumination.
mukta-m0-p19-v454.inference: Therefore, the mind is purified by the illumination composed by Rāmakaṇṭha.
uncertainties: The compound structure allows reading the mind as purified by the light composed by Rāmakaṇṭha.

mukta-m0-p19-v455.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p19-v455.question: In what manner has the purpose of the examination of the triad of jewels been revealed?
premises: The subject is the examination of the triad of jewels.
Its purpose or meaning is the object of revelation.
The revelation is done in a concise manner.
mukta-m0-p19-v455.inference: Therefore, the purpose of the examination of the triad of jewels has been revealed briefly.
